changes.before: I'm the son of this century's last samurai.
changes.after: Sorry. I'm the son of this century's last samurai.
changes.japanese: わるいな。ぼくは今世紀最後のサムライの子でね
changes.note: Restores the source's opening わるいな ('Sorry').

changes.japanese: だれも私に追いつけない・・・
changes.note: 追いつけない means cannot catch up, not 'is pursuing'. The object 'with me' is explicit in Japanese but safely implicit in natural English here, keeping the fixed string shorter than the current line.
The source asks whether the other person can run together with her; it does not say 'run away'.

changes.before: No. A spy and a salesman are a bad match.
changes.japanese: ヤだ。スパイと営業マンはお断り
changes.note: お断り rejects the categories/roles; the source does not say they are a bad romantic match.

changes.japanese: わたしに挑んではならないのよ・・・
changes.note: 挑んではならない is prohibition ('must not / don't challenge me'), not the previously proposed and incorrect 'you'll have to challenge me'.
Natural English preserving the source's 'again, alone' meaning and pause structure.
Restores the compact here/now motif that echoes the opening narration.
